WITH fact_revenue AS (
        SELECT o_custkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS probe_revenue
        FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
          AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-10-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH
          AND l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o_custkey)
        SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(probe_revenue) AS revenue, c_acctbal,
            n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
        FROM fact_revenue JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey
        JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
        GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment
        ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

        SELECT o_custkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS probe_revenue
        FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
          AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-10-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH
          AND l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o_custkey)
        SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(probe_revenue) AS revenue, c_acctbal,
            n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
        FROM fact_revenue JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey
        JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
        GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment
        ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

			p_partkey = ps_partkey
			and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	)
order by
	s_acctbal desc,
	n_name,
	s_name,
	p_partkey
limit 100

select
	s_acctbal,
	s_name,
	n_name,
	p_partkey,
	p_mfgr,
	s_address,
	s_phone,
	s_comment
from
	part,
	supplier,
	partsupp,
	nation,
	region
where
	p_partkey = ps_partkey
	and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
	and p_size = 15
	and p_type like '%BRASS'
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	and ps_supplycost = (
		select
			min(ps_supplycost)
		from
			partsupp,
			supplier,
			nation,
			region
		where
			p_partkey = ps_partkey
			and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	)
order by
	s_acctbal desc,
	n_name,
	s_name,
	p_partkey
limit 100

-- using default substitutions

select
	s_name,
	s_address
from
	supplier,
	nation
where
	s_suppkey in (
		select
			ps_suppkey
		from
			partsupp
		where
			ps_partkey in (
				select
					/*+ BROADCAST */ p_partkey
				from
					part
				where
					p_name like 'forest%'
			)
			and ps_availqty > (
				select
					0.5 * sum(l_quantity)
				from
					lineitem
				where
					l_partkey = ps_partkey
					and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey
					and l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'
					and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
			)
	)
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'CANADA'
order by
	s_name

WITH witness AS (
        SELECT l_orderkey, MIN(CAST(l_suppkey AS INT)) AS probe_all_min,
            MAX(CAST(l_suppkey AS INT)) AS probe_all_max,
            MIN(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate > l_commitdate THEN CAST(l_suppkey AS INT) END) AS probe_late_min,

        FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey)
        SELECT s_name, COALESCE(SUM(probe_late_count), 0L) AS numwait
        FROM witness JOIN orders ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey
        JOIN supplier ON s_suppkey = probe_late_min

        WHERE probe_all_min <> probe_all_max AND probe_late_min = probe_late_max
          AND o_orderstatus = 'F' AND n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
        GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, s_name LIMIT 100

        SELECT l_orderkey, MIN(CAST(l_suppkey AS INT)) AS probe_all_min,
            MAX(CAST(l_suppkey AS INT)) AS probe_all_max,

            MAX(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate > l_commitdate THEN CAST(l_suppkey AS INT) END) AS probe_late_max,

        FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey)

        GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, s_name LIMIT 100

	) as custsale

	cntrycode

WITH line_revenue AS (
        SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS probe_revenue
        FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate > DATE '1995-03-15' GROUP BY l_orderkey)
        SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(probe_revenue) AS revenue, o_orderdate, o_shippriority
        FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey
        JOIN line_revenue ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1995-03-15'
        GROUP BY l_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_shippriority
        ORDER BY revenue DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 10

select
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year,
	sum(volume) as revenue
from
	(
		select
			n1.n_name as supp_nation,
			n2.n_name as cust_nation,
			year(l_shipdate) as l_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume
		from
			supplier,
			lineitem,
			orders,
			customer,
			nation n1,
			nation n2
		where
			s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
			and c_custkey = o_custkey
			and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey

				or (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' and n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
			)
			and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
	) as shipping
group by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year
order by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year

select
	cntrycode,
	count(*) as numcust,
	sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal
from
	(
		select
			substring(c_phone, 1, 2) as cntrycode,
			c_acctbal
		from
			customer
		where
			substring(c_phone, 1, 2) in
				('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
			and c_acctbal > (
				select
					avg(c_acctbal)
				from
					customer
				where
					c_acctbal > 0.00
					and substring(c_phone, 1, 2) in
						('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
			)
			and not exists (
				select
					*
				from
					orders
				where
					o_custkey = c_custkey
			)
	) as custsale
group by
	cntrycode
order by
	cntrycode

-- using default substitutions

select
	cntrycode,
	count(*) as numcust,
	sum(c_acctbal) as totacctbal
from
	(
		select
			substring(c_phone, 1, 2) as cntrycode,
			c_acctbal
		from
			customer
		where
			substring(c_phone, 1, 2) in
				('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
			and c_acctbal > (
				select
					avg(c_acctbal)
				from
					customer
				where
					c_acctbal > 0.00
					and substring(c_phone, 1, 2) in
						('13', '31', '23', '29', '30', '18', '17')
			)
			and not exists (
				select
					*
				from
					orders
				where
					o_custkey = c_custkey
			)
	) as custsale
group by
	cntrycode
order by
	cntrycode

-- using default substitutions

select
	n_name,
	sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue
from
	(SELECT c.* FROM customer c
            WHERE c_nationkey IN (SELECT /*+ BROADCAST */ n_nationkey
                FROM nation JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'ASIA')) AS customer,
	orders,
	lineitem,
	supplier,
	nation,
	region
where
	c_custkey = o_custkey
	and l_orderkey = o_orderkey
	and l_suppkey = s_suppkey
	and c_nationkey = s_nationkey
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'ASIA'
	and o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'
	and o_orderdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
group by
	n_name
order by
	revenue desc

select
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year,
	sum(volume) as revenue
from
	(
		select
			n1.n_name as supp_nation,
			n2.n_name as cust_nation,
			year(l_shipdate) as l_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume
		from
			supplier,
			lineitem,
			orders,
			customer,
			nation n1,
			nation n2
		where
			s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
			and c_custkey = o_custkey
			and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
			and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
			and (
				(n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' and n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')
				or (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' and n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
			)
			and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
	) as shipping
group by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year
order by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year

-- using default substitutions

select
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year,
	sum(volume) as revenue
from
	(
		select
			n1.n_name as supp_nation,
			n2.n_name as cust_nation,
			year(l_shipdate) as l_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume
		from
			supplier,
			lineitem,
			orders,
			customer,
			nation n1,
			nation n2
		where
			s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
			and c_custkey = o_custkey
			and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
			and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
			and (
				(n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' and n2.n_name = 'GERMANY')
				or (n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' and n2.n_name = 'FRANCE')
			)
			and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
	) as shipping
group by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year
order by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year

WITH region_customers AS (
        SELECT c_custkey FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
        JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA'),
        region_orders AS (
        SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(region_customers) */ o_orderkey, YEAR(o_orderdate) AS o_year
        FROM orders JOIN region_customers ON o_custkey = c_custkey
        WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31'),
        supplier_flags AS (
        SELECT s_suppkey, n_name = 'BRAZIL' AS probe_brazil
        FROM supplier JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey)
        SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(part, supplier_flags) SHUFFLE_HASH(region_orders) */ o_year,
            SUM(CASE WHEN probe_brazil THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END)
                / SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mkt_share
        FROM lineitem JOIN part ON l_partkey = p_partkey
        JOIN region_orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        JOIN supplier_flags ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey
        WHERE p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
        GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year

WITH region_customers AS (
        SELECT c_custkey FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
        JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE r_name = 'AMERICA'),
        region_orders AS (
        SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(region_customers) */ o_orderkey, YEAR(o_orderdate) AS o_year
        FROM orders JOIN region_customers ON o_custkey = c_custkey
        WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31'),
        supplier_flags AS (
        SELECT s_suppkey, n_name = 'BRAZIL' AS probe_brazil
        FROM supplier JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey)
        SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(part, supplier_flags) SHUFFLE_HASH(region_orders) */ o_year,
            SUM(CASE WHEN probe_brazil THEN l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) ELSE 0 END)
                / SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS mkt_share
        FROM lineitem JOIN part ON l_partkey = p_partkey
        JOIN region_orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        JOIN supplier_flags ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey
        WHERE p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
        GROUP BY o_year ORDER BY o_year

-- using default substitutions

select
	nation,
	o_year,
	sum(amount) as sum_profit
from
	(
		select
			n_name as nation,
			year(o_orderdate) as o_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity as amount
		from
			part,
			supplier,
			lineitem,
			(SELECT ps.* FROM partsupp ps
            WHERE ps_partkey IN (SELECT /*+ BROADCAST */ p_partkey FROM part
                                WHERE p_name LIKE '%green%' AND p_partkey IS NOT NULL)) AS partsupp,
			orders,
			nation
		where
			s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and ps_partkey = l_partkey
			and p_partkey = l_partkey
			and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and p_name like '%green%'
	) as profit
group by
	nation,
	o_year
order by
	nation,
	o_year desc

	(

			orders,

			and ps_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and ps_partkey = l_partkey
			and p_partkey = l_partkey
			and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and p_name like '%green%'
	) as profit
group by
	nation,
	o_year
order by
	nation,
	o_year desc

WITH fact_revenue AS (
        SELECT o_custkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS probe_revenue
        FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
          AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-10-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH
          AND l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o_custkey)
        SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(probe_revenue) AS revenue, c_acctbal,
            n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
        FROM fact_revenue JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey
        JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
        GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment
        ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

        SELECT o_custkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS probe_revenue
        FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
        WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
          AND o_orderdate < DATE '1993-10-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH
          AND l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY o_custkey)
        SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(probe_revenue) AS revenue, c_acctbal,
            n_name, c_address, c_phone, c_comment
        FROM fact_revenue JOIN customer ON c_custkey = o_custkey
        JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
        GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal, c_phone, n_name, c_address, c_comment
        ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

WITH revenue0 AS (
                SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_no,
                       SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue
                FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01'
                  AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' + INTERVAL '3' MONTH
                GROUP BY l_suppkey),
            marked AS (SELECT *, MAX(total_revenue) OVER () AS probe_max FROM revenue0)
            SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_address, s_phone, total_revenue
            FROM supplier JOIN marked ON s_suppkey = supplier_no
            WHERE total_revenue = probe_max ORDER BY s_suppkey

		and l_quantity >= 20 and l_quantity <= 20 + 10

select

	s_name,
	n_name,
	p_partkey,
	p_mfgr,
	s_address,
	s_phone,
	s_comment
from
	part,
	supplier,
	partsupp,
	nation,
	region
where
	p_partkey = ps_partkey
	and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
	and p_size = 15
	and p_type like '%BRASS'
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	and ps_supplycost = (
		select
			min(ps_supplycost)
		from
			partsupp,
			supplier,
			nation,
			region
		where
			p_partkey = ps_partkey
			and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	)
order by
	s_acctbal desc,
	n_name,
	s_name,
	p_partkey
limit 100

-- using default substitutions

select
	s_name,
	s_address
from
	supplier,
	nation
where
	s_suppkey in (
		select
			ps_suppkey
		from
			partsupp
		where
			ps_partkey in (
				select
					/*+ BROADCAST */ p_partkey
				from
					part
				where
					p_name like 'forest%'
			)
			and ps_availqty > (
				select
					0.5 * sum(l_quantity)
				from
					lineitem
				where
					l_partkey = ps_partkey
					and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey
					and l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'
					and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
			)
	)
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'CANADA'
order by
	s_name

        GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, s_name LIMIT 100

	) as custsale

	cntrycode

	cntrycode

select

	sum(volume) as revenue
from
	(
		select
			n1.n_name as supp_nation,
			n2.n_name as cust_nation,
			year(l_shipdate) as l_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume
		from
			supplier,
			lineitem,

			nation n2

			s_suppkey = l_suppkey

			)
			and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
	) as shipping
group by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year
order by
	supp_nation,
	cust_nation,
	l_year
